scheme_name: Scholarship for C.G. Domicile Students Pursuing Engineering Courses Outside Chhattisgarh State
other_conditions: Must be enrolled in a recognized engineering college outside Chhattisgarh
Must be studying in IIT/NIT/IISc or an AICTE‑approved institution
Must be enrolled in the first year of a B.E./B.Tech course
Must have secured at least 60% marks in the 12th examination
Must not be receiving any other scholarship from the state/central government or other sources
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2000 per month to cover educational expenses.
